title: Private/VPC deployment — demo slot confirmation & kickoff plan
text:
Private/VPC deployment — demo slot confirmation & kickoff plan

['From: noreply@redwood.inference.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@northridgelabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for signing up — next steps for Private deployment demo

Hi Samira,

Thanks for starting the Private deployment trial with Redwood Inference. We received your self-serve intake and an SDR will reach out to schedule a short technical kickoff/demo for your VPC/on-prem evaluation.

What to expect:
- 30–45 minute demo focused on onboarding, network requirements, and security evidence
- Attendees we recommend: your infra lead (network), your security/compliance owner, and one business stakeholder
- We’ll share a checklist before the call to speed the compliance review

An SDR will propose times in a separate email. If you already have a preferred slot, reply with 2 options and timezone.

Cheers,
Redwood Inference (automated)
', 'From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.dev>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@northridgelabs.com>; Jared Lee <jared.lee@northridgelabs.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.dev>
Date: 2027-06-15T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — proposed demo times

Hi Samira / Jared —

Thanks for signing up. I’m Aditya, the SDR covering Northridge Labs. Quick availability from our side next week (all times PDT):
- Tue 2027-06-22 09:30–10:15
- Thu 2027-06-24 13:00–13:45
- Fri 2027-06-25 11:00–11:45

If none work, send 2 windows that do and I’ll loop in Marissa (AE) and Olga (Solutions) for the technical parts.

A couple items we usually cover in the kickoff: network diagram and firewall rules, data residency questions, KMS/HSM integration overview, and an initial rollout plan.

Best,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.dev
', 'From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@northridgelabs.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.dev>
Cc: Jared Lee <jared.lee@northridgelabs.com>; it-security@north-labs.com
Date: 2027-06-15T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — proposed demo times

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the options. Thu 2027-06-24 13:00–13:45 PDT looks good for our initial demo. Please note: our security lead (it-security@north-labs.com) needs to see any evidence checklist ahead of the call. Also, could you confirm whether the demo will include a short walkthrough of the audit log and retention settings? Those are a priority for us.

Attendees on our side: Samira Khan (Product), Jared Lee (Infra), Priya N. (Security — on cc alias).

Thanks,
Samira
Product Manager — Northridge Labs
', 'From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.dev>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@northridgelabs.com>; Jared Lee <jared.lee@northridgelabs.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.dev>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.dev>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.dev>
Date: 2027-06-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — proposed demo times

Thanks Samira — confirmed for Thu 2027-06-24 13:00–13:45 PDT. Calendar invite with dial-in and a short agenda will be sent; provisional Google invite id included in related_links.

What I’ll prepare and share before the call (attached):
- Redwood kickoff agenda (30–45m) — highlights: networking checklist, KMS options, audit log demo, rollout phasing
- Security evidence checklist (PDF) — quick list of SOC/ISO artifacts we can provide during evaluation

Marissa (AE) will give a quick commercial overview; Tessa (CS) will join to discuss typical POC timelines and support/SLA expectations. I will run the technical walkthrough and demo the audit logs/retention UI.

Can you confirm the IP range we should expect to see for your sandbox environment (so we can pre-authorize)? If you prefer not to email that, a note in the calendar invite is fine.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Olga Petrov
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.dev
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform

Attachments:
- redwood-kickoff-agenda-v1.md (attachment)
- redwood-security-evidence-checklist.pdf (attachment)', 'From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@northridgelabs.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.dev>; aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.dev>; marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.dev>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@northridgelabs.com>; it-security@north-labs.com
Date: 2027-06-18T18:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — proposed demo times

Hi all — quick update: our audit team just moved their prep blocker onto Thu morning; we need to shift the demo on Thu 2027-06-24 to Fri 2027-06-25 11:00–11:45 PDT (the slot Aditya originally proposed). Can you confirm if the Redwood team can move? If so, we’ll update the invite.

Apologies for the churn — we want Priya from security on the call.

Jared
Infra Lead, Northridge Labs
